Complete the following statements
9 of 17 points
Complete the following statements by choosing ALL that is applicable from the options below.


Tip: Read the statements slowly and clearly whilst understanding the scenario. Then search for the rule in your notes, confirm it and then respond.

1. The مفعول معه is...
*
0/1
...an إسم.
...a حرف.
 
...a فعل.
Correct answer
...an إسم.

3. The و of the مفعول معه signifes...
*
0/1
...association of what is after it with what is before it when the action is conducted.
...the state of what is before it while the action is conducted.
...the greatness of what is after it which deems the action necessary due to it being an oath.
...co-equailty of what is after it with what is before it when the action is conducted.
 
Correct answer
...association of what is after it with what is before it when the action is conducted.

4. The مفعول معه ...
*
0/1
...can come before the verb.
...must come before the verb.
...must come after the verb.
 
...can come after the verb.
 
Correct answer
...must come after the verb.

5. The مفعول معه ...
*
0/1
...can come after the noun which it would have been عطف to.
 
...can come before the noun which it would have been عطف to.
...must come after the noun which it would have been عطف to.
 
...must come before the noun which it would have been عطف to.
Correct answer
...must come after the noun which it would have been عطف to.

6. The مفعول معه will be necessary...
*
1/1
...If the former noun is a ضمير مجرور متصل and the the latter noun does NOT contain a repitition of the جار.
 
...If the former noun is a ضمير مجرور متصل and the latter noun does contain a repitition of the جار.
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is also emphasised outside of the verb.
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is NOT emphasised outside of the verb.

7. The مفعول معه and the noun which it would have been عطف to...
*
0/1
...can NOT be seperated with a gap.
 
...can be seperated with a gap.
 
Correct answer
...can NOT be seperated with a gap.

8. عطف is not permissible...
*
1/1
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is also emphasised outside of the verb.
...If the former noun is a ضمير مجرور متصل and the the latter noun does NOT contain a repitition of the جار.
 
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is NOT emphasised outside of the verb.
 
...If the former noun is a ضمير مجرور متصل and the latter noun does contain a repitition of the جار.

9. If the فعل or شبه الفعل is literal and عطف is permissible, then...
*
1/1
...only عطف will be permissible.
...only مفعول معه will be permissible.
...both عطف & مفعول معه will be permissible.
 
...both عطف & مفعول معه will Not be permissible.

10. If the فعل or شبه الفعل is not literal, rather it's abstract (in meaning) and عطف is permissible, then...
*
0/1
...both عطف & مفعول معه will Not be permissible.
 
...both عطف & مفعول معه will be permissible.
...only عطف will be permissible.
 
...only مفعول معه will be permissible.
Correct answer
...only عطف will be permissible.

11. If the فعل or شبه الفعل is not literal, rather it's abstract (in meaning) and عطف is NOT permissible, then...
*
0/1
...both عطف & مفعول معه will Not be permissible.
 
...only عطف will be permissible.
...both عطف & مفعول معه will be permissible.
...only مفعول معه will be permissible.
 
Correct answer
...only مفعول معه will be permissible.

12. If labeling the latter noun a معطوف is illogical, then...
*
1/1
...both عطف & مفعول معه will still be permissible because Nahw does not deal with logic.
...the only option will be مفعول معه.

13. If labeling the latter noun a معطوف is illogical, then...
*
1/1
...the only option will be مفعول معه.
 
...both عطف & مفعول معه will still be permissible because Nahw does not deal with logic.

14. If a verb which requires 2 or more doers for it to make sense like تشافه (talking to eachother) is used, then...
*
1/1
...the only option will be عطف.
 
...both عطف & مفعول معه will be permissible.
...the only option will be مفعول معه.

15. If a pronoun is used in reference to the former noun & the مفعول معه, then...
*
0/1
...both the former noun and the latter word (مفعول معه) will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because they are both co-equal.
 
...the former noun will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because the مفعول معه is not co-equal but only an associate.
...the latter noun (مفعول معه) will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because the مفعول معه is more important..
Correct answer
...the former noun will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because the مفعول معه is not co-equal but only an associate.

16. عطف is permissible...
*
1/1
...If the former noun is a ضمير مجرور متصل and the latter noun does contain a repitition of the جار.
 
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is also emphasised outside of the verb.
 
...If the former noun is a ضمير مجرور متصل and the the latter noun does NOT contain a repitition of the جار.
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is NOT emphasised outside of the verb.
...If the former noun is a ضمير مرفوع متصل and it is NOT emphasised outside of the verb and there is also a gap between the ضمير مرفوع متصل and the latter noun.

17. If a pronoun is used in reference to the former noun & the معطوف, then...
*
1/1
...the former noun will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because the معطوف is not co-equal but only an associate.
...the latter noun (معطوف) will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because the معطوف is more important..
...both the former noun and the latter noun (معطوف) will be considered to correlate with the pronoun because they are both co-equal.
